name: electron-multi-tab
description: An Electron multi-tab workspace with independent Vite React apps.

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run dev --workspace @electron-tabs/shell" "npm run dev --workspace @electron-tabs/app-home" "npm run dev --workspace @electron-tabs/app-recorder" "npm run watch:electron" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 http://127.0.0.1:5174 http://127.0.0.1:5175 && cross-env ELECTRON_SHELL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 ELECTRON_APP_HOME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 ELECTRON_APP_RECORDER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5175 nodemon --watch dist-electron --ext js --exec 'electron .'"
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
